metadata.title: Devontez Walker - Hauls in one pass in win
metadata.description: Walker caught one of his two targets for 19 yards during Baltimore's win over the Titans on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Walker managed to record his second reception of the season, as he continues to make a limited impact offensively even with Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) on injured reserve. Walker will look to be more productive during the Week 5 matchup versus the Falcons.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker (groin) off injury report for Week 3
metadata.description: Devontez Walker (groin) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 3's matchup against the Dallas Cowboys.
metadata.analysis: It looks like Walker will be a full go for Week 3, as he is no longer listed with the groin injury that gave him some problems earlier on in the season. He should play and will see more work than usual if Zay Flowers (hamstring) has to miss another game for Baltimore.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker - Low snap count in loss
metadata.description: Walker caught one of his two targets for 47 yards in Sunday's 24-17 loss to the Saints.
metadata.analysis: Walker saw 17 of the Ravens' 58 offensive snaps in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver also saw eight special-teams snaps. Walker saw nearly half as many offensive snaps as LaJohntay Wester (31), even though Zay Flowers (hamstring) could not play in the game. The 2024 fourth-rounder sees most of his usage as a deep threat, but appears to be unable to get reliable snaps with the offense outside of those packages.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker Remains off Many Fantasy Radars
metadata.description: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Devontez Walker missed the Ravens' Week 1 victory over the Indianapolis Colts due to a groin injury. Still, he completed three full practices and shed his injury designation ahead of the Week 2 home opener against the New Orleans Saints. His fellow wide receivers are not as fortunate. The team's WR1, Zay Flowers (hamstring), is doubtful for Sunday's contest, and promising rookie receiver Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) was placed on IR after Wednesday's surgery for a fractured wrist. Walker has primarily been on the outside looking in, but he likely will see an uptick in usage against the Saints as the Ravens enter Week 2 slightly thin at the position. Last week against the Detroit Lions, the Saints gave up over 30 fantasy points to the wide receiver position and 204 total passing yards, which demonstrates the Saints' defense is exploitable through the air. In Week 2 of 2025, Walker hauled in two targets for two receptions, both for touchdowns. Fantasy managers interested in starting Walker this week hope lightning will strike again in Week 2. Moreover, in his seven career games with targets since being drafted in 2024, he has four touchdowns on just 11 targets and seven receptions. Ranked WR87 by Rotoballer, he is a desperation play outside the deepest leagues but an interesting DFS dart throw for those interested in his home run-hitting abilities.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker - Should contribute on offense
metadata.description: With Zay Flowers (hamstring) listed as doubtful, Walker should have a role on offense in Sunday's game against the Saints, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Walker missed Week 1 with a groin injury and now joins an offense that's likely without Flowers and won't have Ja'Kobi Lane (IR - wrist) for at least the next four weeks. Veteran starter Rashod Bateman is the de facto No. 1 receiver, with Walker, LaJohntay Wester, Chris Moore and Elijah Sarratt all candidates for significant playing time as well. Walker was in competition with Lane this summer for the No. 3 receiver job alongside Flowers and Bateman.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker (groin) good to go for Sunday
metadata.description: Devontez Walker (groin) will be good to go for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
metadata.analysis: To no surprise, Walker has received full clearance to play on Sunday after practicing without limitations all week. He is primed to see more work than usual with Zay Flowers (hamstring) doubtful to play for the Ravens in Week 2.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker (groin) practices in full again Thursday
metadata.description: Devontez Walker (groin) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Walker was again a full participant at practice on Thursday, which means that he will almost certainly be available to make his season debut on Sunday. He will likely play a substantial role against the Saints with Zay Flowers (hamstring) trending towards being sidelined for that game.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker - Full practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Walker (groin) was a full participant at the Ravens' practice Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Walker appears to have fully recovered from the groin injury that forced him to miss the team's 41-23 win over the Colts in Week 1. The wide receiver will be a welcomed addition Week 2 versus the Saints after rookie Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) was placed on injured reserve Wednesday.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker (groin) practices in full Wednesday
metadata.description: Devontez Walker (groin) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Walker logged a full practice session on Wednesday despite missing last week's game due to a groin injury of some kind. It looks like he will be back in the lineup in Week 2, which is great timing given that the Ravens will be without Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) and possibly Zay Flowers (hamstring) in their matchup against the Saints this week.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker - Sitting out Sunday
metadata.description: Walker (groin) is inactive for Sunday's clash with the Colts.
metadata.analysis: The wide receiver logged limited practice sessions throughout the week leading up to the game and entered the weekend with a questionable tag. Ravens coach Jesse Minter described the injury as "minor" Tuesday, per Jonas Shaffer of TheBaltimoreBanner.com, but it's at least serious enough to keep Walker out for Week 1.

metadata.title: Devontez Walker (groin) inactive for Week 1
metadata.description: Devontez Walker (groin) is inactive for Week 1 for the Baltimore Ravens against the Indianapolis Colts according to Jamison Hensley.
metadata.analysis: Walker will not suit up after testing his injured groin during pregame activities for head coach Jesse Minter, with superstar Zay Flowers and rookie Ja'Kobi Lane to lead the Baltimore wideout group against the Colts in Week 1.
